column1: # The closed list of Python routes deleted although the deployed ingress still routes their path to Go
# (CHAOS-7294 first). ci/go_served_paths.tsv is a recorded ingress dump and is never edited by hand: a row of
# it whose path no served Python route has passes ci/check_go_served_paths.py (rule 2) ONLY if a row of this
# list names that path. A listed row whose method and path a served Python route still has fails (stale
# entry). An unlisted manifest row with no Python route fails. The list grows only in a PR that deletes the
# route; an entry leaves it when the next ingress dump no longer holds the path.
